title: Social Media Manager
summary: A social media manager runs a brand's Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube and other social pages: planning what to post, talking with followers, working with creators and reporting results. The role sits in a brand's marketing team or an agency and differs from a general digital marketer by focusing on organic content and community more than search or paid ads.
dailyDuties: Plan the weekly and monthly social content calendar
Brief designers and editors on posts, carousels and Reels
Reply to comments and messages and flag complaints
Shortlist and brief influencers and creators for campaigns
Boost top posts and run small paid social campaigns
Report reach, engagement and follower growth each month

skills.expectation: Plan the monthly social media strategy and content calendar across platforms
Reply to comments and messages, moderate the community and watch brand mentions
Plan and brief Reels and Shorts with designers and video editors
Find, brief and manage influencers and creators for campaigns
Boost posts and run basic paid social campaigns on Meta and LinkedIn
Track reach, engagement and follower growth and report what worked
Write captions and post copy that fit the brand voice
Brief agencies and designers and present monthly results to the marketing head
Schedule and monitor posts in a tool such as Hootsuite, Sprout Social or Sprinklr
Make quick social creatives in Canva or Adobe Express
Read paid social results such as cost per result and ROAS
Track traffic from social channels in GA4
Coordinate approvals with brand, legal and product teams

certifications.why: Covers Facebook and Instagram pages, content and basic paid campaigns
